startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Where the crawl begins. You can paste a list, upload a file or point to a Google Sheet.

crawlerType.title: Crawler type
crawlerType.description: **HTTP (Cheerio)** is 10-50x faster and cheaper — use it whenever the content is in the raw HTML. Switch to **Browser (Playwright)** only for sites that render content with JavaScript.

linkStrategy.title: Which links to follow
linkStrategy.description: `same-domain` also follows subdomains, `same-hostname` does not. `all` crawls the whole internet — always pair it with URL globs and a request limit.
enumTitles: Do not follow links (only Start URLs)

includeUrlGlobs.title: Include URL globs
includeUrlGlobs.description: Only enqueue URLs matching these glob patterns, e.g. `https://example.com/blog/**`. Leave empty to allow everything permitted by the link strategy.

excludeUrlGlobs.title: Exclude URL globs
excludeUrlGlobs.description: Never enqueue URLs matching these patterns, e.g. `**/cart/**`, `**?*sort=*`.

maxCrawlDepth.title: Max crawl depth
maxCrawlDepth.description: Start URLs are depth 0. `2` means: start page → its links → their links, then stop enqueueing.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max pages
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Hard stop on the number of pages loaded. Your main cost guard — keep it low on the first run.

extractFields.title: Fields to extract
extractFields.description:
One entry per output column. `selector` is any CSS selector.

- `type`: `text` (default), `html`, `attr`, `exists`, `count`
- `attr`: attribute name, required when `type` is `attr` (e.g. `href`, `content`, `src`)
- `multiple`: `true` returns an array of every match instead of the first one

URLs coming from `href`/`src` attributes are resolved to absolute form automatically.

extractEmails.title: Extract e-mail addresses
extractEmails.description: Collects addresses from `mailto:` links, visible text, Cloudflare-obfuscated nodes and (optionally) the raw HTML.
extractEmails.sectionDescription: Every page's addresses land in its dataset record. A de-duplicated list of all of them is also written to the key-value store as `EMAILS`.

scanRawHtml.title: Also scan raw HTML
scanRawHtml.description: Finds addresses that never render on screen — JSON-LD blocks, `data-` attributes, inline scripts. Higher recall, slightly higher false-positive rate (the built-in filters remove asset filenames, Sentry DSNs and similar noise).

deobfuscateEmails.title: De-obfuscate addresses
deobfuscateEmails.description: Decodes the usual dodges: `name [at] example [dot] com`, `@` HTML entities and Cloudflare e-mail protection.

emailDomainBlocklist.title: Ignored e-mail domains
emailDomainBlocklist.description: Addresses on these domains are dropped. Your entries are added to the built-in list of tracker and placeholder domains.

waitForSelector.title: Wait for selector
waitForSelector.description: Browser mode only — wait until this CSS selector appears before scraping. Useful for content loaded by XHR.

waitForSelectorTimeoutSecs.title: Wait timeout (s)
waitForSelectorTimeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for the selector above before scraping the page anyway.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Strongly recommended. Residential proxies help on sites that block datacenter IPs.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Upper bound on parallel requests. Lower it if the target starts returning 429s.

respectRobotsTxtFile.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxtFile.description: Skip URLs the site disallows for crawlers. Leave this on unless you have a specific reason and the right to ignore it.

saveHtml.title: Save page HTML
saveHtml.description: Adds the full HTML to every dataset record. Makes the dataset very large.

saveText.title: Save page text
saveText.description: Adds the page's visible text to every dataset record.
